scientific_hypothesis: Swapping the layer order to TiO2 (high index) adjacent to air and SiO2 (low index) adjacent to glass, combined with an initialization based on the analytical quarter-wave condition at the spectral center (575 nm), will allow the gradient optimizer to converge to a distinct local minimum with a lower broadband mean reflectance than the SiO2-first configuration found in Round 1.
expected_advantages: Potential to escape the local minimum found in the SiO2-first topology.
Analytical initialization provides a physically grounded starting point closer to the global optimum.
known_risks: The TiO2-first order might yield a higher minimum reflectance due to stronger Fresnel reflections at the first interface if not perfectly tuned.
The quarter-wave thicknesses for 575 nm might fall outside the 40-160 nm bounds or require scaling that distorts the broadband response.
expected_observations: If the hypothesis holds, the optimizer should converge to a solution where best_target_score approaches 1.0 (corresponding to mean reflectance near 0.0) or at least significantly improves over unoptimized guesses, with tightest_margin remaining positive relative to the 40/160 nm bounds.

If the hypothesis fails or the constraints are too tight, best_target_score will plateau at a lower value corresponding to a mean reflectance above 0.03, and valid_candidates may cluster near the boundary limits (40 or 160 nm) indicating the solver is pushing against constraints.
The reflectance spectrum should show a broad dip centered roughly in the 450-700 nm range if successful, or a narrow/shifted dip if the thickness constraints limit performance.
stop_conditions: If best_target_score improves by less than 1e-4 against the historical best for two consecutive rounds of evaluation (within the 64 eval limit), treat the local optimum as found, stop the search, and retain the current best thickness pair.
If the optimizer exhausts the 64 solver evaluations without converging to a stable point, stop and report the best valid candidate found so far.
If all generated candidates violate the 40-160 nm thickness constraints (valid_candidates = 0), stop and flag the constraint set as infeasible for this topology.
